title: Install and sign in to an agent from inside the app, one shared run per agent
prompt:
A person without the Claude Code or Codex CLI, or who is signed out of it, has to leave TerminalX to fix that. Add an in-app setup flow. The agent's official installer runs in an embedded terminal, then its own sign-in runs in the same terminal, and readiness is checked after each step; an exit code alone never claims success. The flow belongs to the window, one per agent, so the welcome screen, Settings › Agents and the new-session view all show the same run wherever it started. That shared flow then has to cope with runs another window started, and with a terminal pane both windows want.

Pure transitions and the store go in a new src/lib/agentSetupFlow.ts, with these exports:
- `type SetupProblem = "permission" | "offline" | "download" | "install" | "login" | "not_found" | "start"`.
- `type AgentSetupFlow = { phase: "idle" } | { phase: "running" | "checking"; step: AgentSetupStep; pane: string; chain: boolean } | { phase: "failed"; step; pane; chain; problem: SetupProblem; detail?: string } | { phase: "done" }`, where `AgentSetupStep` is `"install" | "login"`.
- `SETUP_EXIT = { permission: 70, offline: 71, download: 72, install: 73, login: 74 }`.
- `afterExit(flow, code)`: for a running step, exit 0 becomes checking. A known code becomes failed with that problem, but login only maps `offline` and `login`. Any other code, or a null code, fails as the step itself (install or login). Any flow that is not running is returned unchanged.
- `afterCheck(flow, readiness)`: only for checking. After install, `signed_out` becomes running login when `chain` is set (otherwise idle), `ready` becomes done, `missing` fails with `not_found`, and `unknown` becomes idle. After login, `ready` becomes done and `signed_out` fails with `login`. A running flow is unchanged.
- `startAgentSetup(harness, step, { chain = false } = {})`, `retryAgentSetup(harness)`, `cancelAgentSetup(harness)`, `getAgentSetupFlow(harness)`, `useAgentSetupFlow(harness)`, `useAgentSetupFlows()`, `setupActive(flow)`, `resetAgentSetupFlows()` and `useSetupTerminalHost(pane: string | null): boolean`.

Behaviour, through `invoke` and `listen`:
- A step starts with `invoke("agent_setup_start", { id, harness, step })`, where a new run's pane id matches `setup:<harness>:<random lowercase alphanumeric>`. A chained login and every retry reuse the same pane. A run that is already going is not started a second time.
- The flow follows `pty_exit` events whose `id` is its pane and ignores all others. After a 0 exit it calls `refreshHarnesses()` from src/lib/sessions.ts and checks readiness with `invoke("check_agent_readiness", ...)`.
- After an install, an `unknown` answer is asked again twice, 1.5 s apart, before it is accepted. After a sign-in, `unknown` is accepted at once.
- Every view learns the result without a new check: `useAgentReadiness` in src/lib/agentReadiness.ts shows the readiness the flow observed. Add `forgetReadiness()` there to clear its cache.
- On done, it kills the pane (`invoke("pty_kill", { id })`) and calls `disposeInstance(id)` from src/lib/terminal.ts.
- Cancel kills the pane and returns to idle. A late exit from the cancelled run changes nothing, and the next run gets a new pane. If the cancel comes while `agent_setup_start` is still pending, the pane is killed again once the start resolves.
- When `agent_setup_start` is refused, ask `invoke("agent_setup_running", ...)`. If it answers `{ pane, step }`, follow that run as if this window had started it. If the answer is null and readiness is now known, go idle and tell the views. Otherwise fail with problem `"start"` and the refusal message as `detail`. If the run being followed is in the pane this window was about to use, keep that terminal (do not dispose it) and follow it with `chain: false`.
- `useSetupTerminalHost(pane)`: only the most recently mounted host of a pane shows its terminal. When that host unmounts, the previous one takes it back. A null pane gives false.

Also add the backend commands (`agent_setup_start`, `agent_setup_running`, in src-tauri harness/setup.rs) and the setup UI (src/components/session/AgentSetup.tsx, Settings › Agents card, the welcome screen).
notes:
Source: PR #799, four commits.
Chain: b1558837 introduces src/lib/agentSetupFlow.ts (transitions, store, startAgentSetup), the readiness cache hooks in agentReadiness.ts, AgentSetup.tsx and the Rust harness/setup.rs. 51e430e0 changes agentSetupFlow.ts, agentReadiness.ts and AgentSetup.tsx so that a fresh Codex install's sign-in keeps going. cc5a7b95 (the review round) changes the same three files plus setup.rs: one setup per agent, following another window's run through agent_setup_running. b52df201 changes agentSetupFlow.ts once more to keep the terminal when the run it follows is in its own pane.
Every later commit edits agentSetupFlow.ts functions from the first one.
Replaying only the PR's own commits onto startCommit passes the check, so it does not depend on what main merged into the branch.
The check is the PR's new agentSetupFlow.test.ts. Its Rust and UI parts are not checked.
